title: Egyptian Chicken Italian Fry
description: An Italian-inspired dish featuring succulent chicken with a Middle Eastern twist. This chicken stir-fry is packed with flavor and can be made in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: egyptian spices
ingredients.notes: blend of cumin, coriander, and paprika

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the eggplant to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the egyptian spices, stir-fry sauce, and basil.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
